title: NASA Completes Artemis III Booster Stacking, Shares Status Update
detail: NASA finished attaching nose cones to the Artemis III twin solid rocket boosters in the VAB (Sept 30). All four RS-25 engines are installed on the core stage, which is to join the boosters in coming weeks. A tanking test of the short stack at Pad 39B is planned in coming months; the crew (Bresnik, Rubio, Douglas, Parmitano) continues training.
